Connect the Future, Connect ATX3.0
100% ATX 3.0 Compatible
Cooler Master took the initiative and continuously developing our first ATX3.0 Power Supply lineup. Compliant with ATX3.0 standard and 12VHPWR connectors, the GX Gold 1050/1250 ATX3.0 can fully support the peak power drawn by the 40 series RTX graphic cards and whole system.
Industrial-grade Temperature Resilience
The GX Gold 1050/1250 ATX3.0 has improved to operate safely at up to 50 degrees Celsius ambient for high-end computer, overclocking and other high intensity applications. Such a high threshold greatly enhances the performance of your PSU and your system.
Fully Modular Cabling
The fully modular version of the GX Gold 1050/1250 ATX3.0 comes with a set of flat black cables that can be customized to each user's individual needs. It's designed for easy cable management that each system only needs to include the cables required. This unused space within the chassis allows for reduced clutter, better airflow and aesthetic, thereby improving your system's overall cooling.

While there are a range of efficiency options, 80 PLUS Gold has been the ideal choice for the last several years and continues to be seen as the standard for much of the world. The GX Gold 1050/1250 ATX3.0 features 80 PLUS Gold certification, guaranteeing 90% efficiency at typical load.

The fully modular version of the GX Gold 1050/1250 ATX3.0 comes with a set of flat black cables that can be customized to each user's individual needs. It's designed for easy cable management that each system only needs to include the cables required. This unused space within the chassis allows for reduced clutter, better airflow and aesthetic, thereby improving your system's overall cooling.
